Results.ReviewText: The grill cooks very well! No disappointment there. I am however surprised that the charcoal ash collection bucket is a challenge to attach underneath the grill. I am finding the best method to secure it requires me to get on the ground and make sure the three contacts are engaged. Ours has come loose and fallen down a couple of times which spreads ash all over the ground. Also, there is only one Velcro strip to attach the grill cover. Another one or two Velcro attachment strips would secure the cover so I don't need to go on a search mission to find my cover after a moderate wind.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for being a Weber fan! We understand that learning how to grill with a new fuel type can take some practice, and we are here to help!

To begin, we understand your frustration with the center of your Gourmet Barbeque System (GBS) cooking grates. As you use the grill more, the grates will acquire seasoning that helps to hold the center in place. 

Regarding the quickly-burning charcoal issue, we recommend updating your damper settings slightly. For high heat, leave the bottom damper at the totally open position but close the TOP damper about halfway. 

When you add a chimney of properly-started charcoal to your grill, this setting should allow you to easily reach 450-500 F. You will also maintain the target temperature for longer with the same coals since they will burn more slowly. 

To learn more about getting your charcoal started, please see this link:
https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/burning-questions/how-to-use-a-chimney-starter/weber-30557.html

Our Care team is here to help! Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
I have used gas grills for a number of years but recently down-sized and got a charcoal kettle based on very high reviews from a number of sources. These are very initial, novice impressions and I am happy to be schooled.

I really wanted to love this product, but now I'm wondering if I should have paid a third as much and got some non-descript brand from Walmart. 

Two surprisingly mediocre features in an otherwise bullet-proof product:

First, the warming rack is awkward and its placement is indeterminate and it can actually slip through the grates. This should not happen. Either make it securable to the stable grilling platform or don't have it.

Second, the central "cut-away" in the grilling surface can actually fall through which is puzzling. Why have a portion of the cooking surface that can be nudged or jostled to fall on the charcoal below? 

Third and again, I am a novice with charcoal, but the design seems to require A LOT of briquettes to maintain high heat. I filled a chimney with briquettes to an inch from the top and got them volcano hot in ten minutes. But once I spread them they quickly burned through and the heat rapidly dropped. No idea how this design gets even close to 500 F but again, that may be my mistake with the venting (I kept the bottom and top vents fully open). Would greatly appreciate any tips that don't involve two whole chimneys of charcoal or a giant pyramid with a pint of lighter fluid.

Best regards.
Results.Title: Recent switch to charcoal from gas

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
